name: 10-one-bridge
note: Explicit MAC and ipv6; one .startup file for five devices (partial-startup path). b1.startup builds an in-device Linux bridge and enslaves all four interfaces to it; the bridge's carrier follows its ports asynchronously, so `mainbridge` is briefly DOWN/NO-CARRIER after `ip link set up`. One recording caught the transition mid-flight — `ip -br link` said DOWN/NO-CARRIER while `ip -j addr`, run a moment later in the same probe pass, already said UP. settle_seconds pins the observation to the converged side. The converged state is what the lab is *for*, and it is stable once reached.
